dogecoin.text: Y’all need to start tweeting about #dogecoin and #dogetothemoon during the week when the market is actually open. I only ever see it trending on the weekend which is kinda counterintuitive. Gotta try to move the market when it’s actually open and active.
#dogecoin is still doing alright but we need to get that enthusiasm back and get it back up to where we know it can get. Can’t let a little dip stop all that progress.
Hey, $doge is taking back off again! You love to see the recovery.
